summary: Implemented workflow template gallery with 3 pre-built templates (Invoice Extraction, Contract Analysis, Form Processing). Created TemplateGallery component with preview diagrams, detail modals, and one-click 'Use Template' functionality. Added LOAD_TEMPLATE action to the workflow editor hook for instantiating templates with fresh IDs. Templates are immediately deployable and produce valid workflows. Users can customize loaded templates by adding/removing nodes and connections. Integrated as a tabbed sidebar in the WorkflowEditor alongside the existing Node Palette. Backend WorkflowTemplatesService provides createWorkflowFromTemplate for persistence. Comprehensive test coverage with 43 new tests across template data validation, hook integration, and component behavior.
